attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Alpine 3.23, extlinux bootloader) to boot with audit=1 persistently by appending it to default_kernel_opts in /etc/update-extlinux.conf and regenerating /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux. Verified persistence and correctness across an actual node restart: boot_id changed from b1181481-d371-4b80-b422-69c46e7c2e7c to 83f0baed-bc0a-49fe-8eb8-43fad52a38e4, post-reboot /proc/cmdline includes audit=1, and dmesg shows the audit subsystem enabled and initialized (audit_enabled=1) with no failure messages.
